pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 160 °C·d above 4 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1250 °C·d$(). Best near 18 °C; stops above 30 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -5 °C (-4 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-6.8 (tolerates 5.5-7.5). Roots 0.6 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 110, P 20, K 200 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 357 cwt/ac (40 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Carrot.
